newsitem.title: CANADA: Vancouver Airport April cargo down for sked carriers.
newsitem.headline: Vancouver Airport April cargo down for sked carriers.

text.p: Scheduled carriers handled 2.4 percent less cargo at Vancouver International Airport in April than in April 1996, but overall cargo traffic was 4.8 percent higher because of gains by integrated and express carriers.

The integtated carriers, once minor players in the Vancouver market, accounted for almost one-fifth of the airport's traffic in April 1997, according to statistics published by the local airport authority.
Integrated carriers increased their tonnage by 50.5 percent in April to 4,042 tonnes, up from 2,685 tonnes a year earlier.
Scheduled carriers moved 16,889 tonnes through Vancouver, down from 17,296 in April 1996. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
